question.prompt:
In a rectangular prism, one edge has direction vector \((4,0,0)\), and another edge has direction vector \((0,3,0)\). What is their dot product?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_h164_q1_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: \(4\times0+0\times3+0\times0=0\), so the two edges are perpendicular.
solutions.title: Coordinate dot product
